title: A registered chat host on the owner's Mac runs real claude -p
evidence: npm run host:enroll / npm run host (scripts/host.sh): one locked folder ~/BarkBot/home, claude in plan mode. Enrollment is owner-only: the owner issues it in Studio > Chat hosts. Seen live 2026-11-11 on guerrilla (after Barkpark #25636 and #25679): the host 'BarkBot Mac' is online with claude installed and signed in; a message posted to a registered_host session answered 202 and came back as session_started, turn_started, text_delta, item_completed, turn_completed in about 12 s. Missing: a repeatable check (this was one live run by hand).
